title: 第6章 惊变
slug: 韶光慢全本免费-韶光慢最新章节列表
content_zh:
想去杏子林，就要经过白云村。
正值黄昏将至之际，马蹄声打破了村庄的宁静。
村人三三两两聚在一起，注视着来人。
他们很安静，四人却从这种令人压抑的安静中感受到一种异样的气氛。
没有高声谈笑的村民，没有见到陌生人好奇围观的幼童，这里的人竟是人人穿白，在漫天云霞的衬托下，明明春已来，却让人心生寒意。
“拾曦，我怎么觉得这些村人有些奇怪，要不要下马去打听一下？”杨二驱马凑到池灿身边问道。
坐在池灿身前的乔昭望着眼前熟悉又陌生的一切，目光从村民那一张张木然悲哀的面庞上掠过，心忽地一沉，呼吸困难起来。
她说不清是为什么，心好像陡然间被巨石压住，那马蹄声仿佛不是踩在地上，而是踏在她心头。
“快走……”乔昭竭力不让人察觉她的异样，艰难吐出两个字。
池灿同样察觉出不对劲，对杨二道：“不用耽误时间，我认识路。”
他双腿用力一夹马腹，那马就跑得快起来，朱彦与杨二忙跟上。
三匹健马扬长而去，留下一路烟尘，村民们互看一眼，摇头叹息，默默散了。
绕过村子，遥遥就望到了那片杏子林。
这个时候杏花已开，远远望去，犹如大片绚丽云霞，与天际晚霞相映成辉，美不胜收。
乔昭不自觉红了眼圈。
祖父曾说过，杏花耐寒，天气越冷花开越早，且花期远比桃花长。
祖父是欣赏杏花的。
而今杏花犹在，她最敬爱的人却已经长眠。
“驾——”池灿显然无心欣赏美景，转瞬来到杏子林前，翻身下马，把马拴在一棵树上，领着众人从杏林中的一条小路穿梭而过。
乔昭悄悄握了拳，手心全是汗水。

她居然会紧张成这个样子，就是当初大婚，都不曾如此。
这就是近乡情怯吧，人之常情。乔昭这样安慰自己。
走在她前面的池灿忽然停了下来。
乔昭心头一跳：“怎么了——”
后面的话戛然而止，眼前的断壁残垣让她瞬间白了脸，身形摇摇欲坠，要死死抓住身旁之物才勉强稳住身子。
池灿目光下移，看着少女抓住自己衣袖的手。
那只手小巧纤细，柔白如玉，其上的青筋清晰可见。
池灿沉默了片刻，看杨二一眼。
杨二会意点头，前去查探。
片刻后他回转，语气沉重：“是火灾，看样子就是前不久的事。”
三人面面相觑，忽然就明白了那些村民的异样。
以乔家在此地的声望善行，家中遭此惨变，村民为其穿白并不奇怪。
风起杏花落，如簌簌而下的白雪一般清冷。
一时之间无人言语。
乔昭的心比燕城城墙上那一箭穿心还要痛。
不，这根本无法相提并论。
那时，一箭穿心而过，她瞬间痛过，甚至还来不及再体会就陷入黑暗。再睁眼，她就成了小姑娘黎昭。
而这一刻，这痛绵绵不断，永无绝期。
她做错了什么，要死而复生，面对这样的惨景？
乔昭下意识攥紧拳。

“你抓痛我了。”池灿淡淡道。
杨二与朱彦对视一眼。
别人不知道，身为好友的他们却清楚，池灿此刻心情很糟糕。
奔波千里而来，却是这么一个结果，换作谁心情都不会好的。更可况，除却所求落空，眼见乔家如此遭遇，没有人能心里好受。
乔昭回过神来，迎上那个俊美无俦的男子冷然淡漠的脸，慢慢松了手。
祖父教她自尊、自立，她的心情当然不能麻烦别人收拾。
“走吧，去问问那些村民，到底发生了什么事。”池灿转身走进杏林。
乔昭深一脚浅一脚跟着，双腿如灌了铅，慢慢落到最后。
朱彦回了头，停住脚步等她。
小姑娘虽然没有哭，可给他的感觉，哀恸极了。
她为何如此？
“你还好吧？”
乔昭看着他，牵了牵嘴角：“显而易见，我很不好。”
朱彦犹豫一下，从袖中掏出一方折叠整齐的洁白手帕递过去：“若是难受，哭出来更好。”
尽管他不知道小姑娘为何伤心成这个样子，心中却生出几分不忍。
原来，有的时候女孩子不哭比哭起来，更让人觉得心酸。
这样的好意，在这个特殊的时刻，乔昭无法拒绝，也不想拒绝。
她伸手接过手帕，擦了擦眼，又擦了擦鼻子，真心实意谢道：“朱大哥，你真是个好人。”

content_en:
If you want to go to the Apricot Grove, you have to pass by Baiyun Village.
Just as dusk was approaching, the sound of horse hooves broke the tranquility of the village.
The villagers gathered together in twos and threes and watched the visitor.
They were very quiet, but the four of them felt a strange atmosphere from this oppressive silence.
There were no villagers chatting and laughing loudly, and no strangers were seen watching curious children. Everyone here was actually wearing white. Against the backdrop of the clouds in the sky, it was clear that spring had arrived, but it made people feel chilly.
"Shi Xi, why do I feel that these villagers are a little strange? Do you want to get off the horse and ask about it?" Yang Er rode up to Chi Can and asked.
Qiao Zhao, who was sitting in front of Chi Can, looked at everything familiar and unfamiliar in front of him. His eyes passed over the dull and sad faces of the villagers. His heart suddenly sank and he became breathless.
She couldn't explain why, but her heart seemed to be suddenly pressed by a boulder, and the sound of horse hooves seemed not to be on the ground, but on her heart.
"Let's go..." Qiao Zhao tried her best to prevent others from noticing her strangeness, and struggled to say two words.
Chi Can also noticed something was wrong and said to Yang Er, "No need to waste time, I know the way."
He squeezed the horse's belly with both legs, and the horse started running faster. Zhu Yan and Yang Er hurriedly kept up.
The three healthy horses galloped away, leaving behind a trail of smoke and dust. The villagers looked at each other, shook their heads, sighed, and dispersed silently.
After walking around the village, I saw the apricot forest in the distance.
At this time, the apricot blossoms are in bloom. Looking from a distance, they look like a vast expanse of gorgeous clouds, complementing the sunset in the sky. It is so beautiful.
Qiao Zhao's eyes turned red unconsciously.
My grandfather once said that apricot flowers are cold-resistant. The colder the weather, the earlier the flowers bloom, and the flowering period is much longer than that of peach flowers.
My grandfather admired apricot blossoms.
Now the apricot blossoms are still there, but the person she loves the most has fallen asleep.
"Drive -" Chi Can obviously had no intention of enjoying the beautiful scenery. He arrived in front of the apricot grove in a flash, dismounted from his horse, tied the horse to a tree, and led the crowd through a path in the apricot grove.
Qiao Zhao quietly clenched his fists, his palms covered with sweat.
She was actually so nervous, even when she was getting married, she had never been like this before.
This is just shyness when you are close to home, it is human nature. Qiao Zhao comforted himself in this way.
Chi Can, who was walking in front of her, suddenly stopped.
Qiao Zhao's heart skipped a beat: "What's wrong——"
The words that followed came to an abrupt end, and the ruins of the wall in front of her made her face turn pale instantly. Her figure was shaky, and she had to hold on to something beside her to barely stabilize herself.
Chi Can lowered his gaze and looked at the girl's hand grabbing his sleeve.
The hand was small and slender, as soft and white as jade, and the veins on it were clearly visible.
Chi Can was silent for a moment and looked at Yang Er.
Yang Er nodded knowingly and went to investigate.
After a moment, he turned around and said in a serious tone: "It was a fire. It seemed like it happened not long ago."
The three of them looked at each other and suddenly understood what was strange about the villagers.
Given the reputation of the Qiao family here and their good deeds, it is not surprising that the villagers had to whitewash their family for such a tragic change.
The wind blows and the apricot blossoms fall, as cool as the white snow falling down.
No one spoke for a moment.
Qiao Zhao's heart hurt more than the arrow piercing his heart on the wall of Yancheng.
No, there's no comparison at all.
At that time, an arrow pierced her heart, and she felt pain instantly, and she fell into darkness before she could even feel it again. When she opened her eyes again, she became the little girl Li Zhao.
And at this moment, the pain is endless and never-ending.
What had she done wrong to come back from the dead and face such a tragic scene?
Qiao Zhao subconsciously clenched his fists.
"You scratched me." Chi Can said lightly.
Yang Er and Zhu Yan looked at each other.
Others don't know, but as good friends, they know that Chi Can is in a bad mood at the moment.
After traveling thousands of miles, this is the result. No one would be in a good mood. What's worse, except for the failure of what they wanted, no one can feel better after seeing the Qiao family suffer like this.
Qiao Zhao came back to his senses and faced the cold and indifferent face of that handsome man. He slowlyLet go.
Her grandfather taught her self-respect and self-reliance. Of course, she should not trouble others to deal with her mood.
"Let's go and ask the villagers what happened." Chi Can turned around and walked into the apricot forest.
Qiao Zhao's legs were filled with lead, and he slowly fell to the end.
Zhu Yan turned around and stopped to wait for her.
Although the little girl didn't cry, she gave him the feeling of being extremely sad.
Why is she like this?
"Are you okay?"
Qiao Zhao looked at him and twitched the corner of his mouth: "Obviously, I'm very bad."
Zhu Yan hesitated, then took out a neatly folded white handkerchief from his sleeve and handed it over: "If you feel uncomfortable, it's better to cry."
Although he didn't know why the little girl was so sad, he felt a bit intolerable in his heart.
It turns out that sometimes it makes people feel more sad when a girl doesn't cry than when she cries.
Such kindness, at this special moment, Qiao Zhao could not refuse, nor did he want to refuse.
She reached out and took the handkerchief, wiped her eyes and nose, and thanked her sincerely: "Brother Zhu, you are such a good person."
